metadata.title: Palo Alto Networks Inc (PANW) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Growth in Next ...

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
-
Next Generation Security ARR: $8.13 billion, 60% year-over-year growth.
-
Revenue: $3 billion, 31% year-over-year growth.
-
Product Revenue: $594 million, 31% year-over-year growth.
-
Services Revenue: $2.4 billion, 31% year-over-year growth.
-
RPO (Remaining Performance Obligation): $18.4 billion, 36% year-over-year growth.
-
Current RPO: $8.3 billion, 34% year-over-year growth.
-
Gross Margin: 75.8% total, with product gross margin at 78.8%.
-
Operating Margin: 21.3% non-GAAP.
-
Free Cash Flow: $910 million, 57% year-over-year increase.
-
Adjusted Free Cash Flow Margin: 37% for fiscal year 2026.
-
EPS (Earnings Per Share): $0.85 non-GAAP, $0.22 GAAP loss per share.
-
Hardware Performance: Best quarter in a decade, with next-generation firewall bookings up nearly 40% year-over-year.
-
SASE ARR: $1.6 billion, 40% year-over-year growth.
-
Software Firewall ARR: Up 25% year-over-year.
-
Prisma AI Customers: Over 300, up from 100 at the end of Q2.
Release Date: June 02, 2026
For the complete transcript of the earnings call, please refer to the full earnings call transcript.
Positive Points
-
Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) delivered a record Q3 performance, surpassing all guided metrics with a 60% year-over-year growth in Next Generation Security ARR, reaching $8.13 billion.
-
The company achieved significant traction in network security and Prisma, which continues to be the fastest scaling product in its history.
-
Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) reported strong growth in hardware, SASE, and software firewalls, with next-generation firewall bookings rising nearly 40% year-over-year.
-
The company secured 110 net new platformizations in Q3, reflecting deep architectural commitments from customers.
-
Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) generated $910 million in adjusted free cash flow, a 57% increase year-over-year, supporting its share repurchase program.
Negative Points
-
The company faces challenges with the prevalence of false positives in AI models, with error rates reaching 25%, which could undermine the speed advantage of automation.
-
Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) is closely monitoring rising component costs, particularly in memory and storage, which could impact future margins.
-
The integration of recent acquisitions, such as CyberArk and Chronosphere, presents potential risks and complexities in achieving synergy targets.
-
There is a need for further development in the observability platform to ensure it remains competitive in the market.
-
The company acknowledges the ongoing challenge of migrating its Prisma Cloud customers to Cortex Cloud, which is expected to take several more months.

Positive Points
Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) delivered a record Q3 performance, surpassing all guided metrics with a 60% year-over-year growth in Next Generation Security ARR, reaching $8.13 billion.
The company achieved significant traction in network security and Prisma, which continues to be the fastest scaling product in its history.

Negative Points

Palo Alto Networks Inc (NASDAQ:PANW) is closely monitoring rising component costs, particularly in memory and storage, which could impact future margins.
The integration of recent acquisitions, such as CyberArk and Chronosphere, presents potential risks and complexities in achieving synergy targets.
There is a need for further development in the observability platform to ensure it remains competitive in the market.
The company acknowledges the ongoing challenge of migrating its Prisma Cloud customers to Cortex Cloud, which is expected to take several more months.
